programme.title: Have A Pet Day
programme.desc: Renowned Golden Bell awarded host Sandy Wu takes her beloved dog Hershey on outings, inviting celebrities and their adorable pets to join in the fun Beyond exploring nature, the show delves into heartfelt conversations about the journey of pet ownership and shares touching stories amid delightful scenery and cuisine The program features various enjoyable activities where owners and pets can bond, creating unforgettable memories through laughter and tears

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: In Birkenhead, Inspector Anthony Joynes is accompanied by the police to attend an unlocked and empty property Inside he finds Teddy, the terrified Terrier cross that has a flea infestation so bad that he's missing half his fur One-year-old Teddy is incredibly nervous, but will he be able to overcome his fears and allow the RSPCA to offer him help?

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Because of her love for cats, Claire carefully created a place called "There is a Cat at the Corner" While enjoying your meals and drinks, more than a dozen beautiful cats are strolling freely in the store, waiting to interact with you up close and enjoy a slow life with you However, if you want to pet the cat yourself and win their favor, you must first understand the nature and preferences of cats! Claire also generously shares her “experiences in ruling over dozens of cats”, which is extremely precious Novice cat lovers should come and have a look!

programme.desc: Brother Hui, who runs an amphibian and reptile store in Xinxing District, Kaohsiung City, has a wide range of knowledge in the field of reptiles He started with red-eared sliders and gradually got in touch with tortoises, lizards, snakes and other reptile pets In Brother Hui's brick-and-mortar store, the most special existence is the two store pets, the South American lizards The male is called Meatball and the female is called Porkball How did their fate with Brother Hui begin? Brother Hui, who has many years of experience in raising South American lizards, also generously share his breeding secrets How to distinguish male and female South American lizards? Brother Hui, who has many years of experience in raising South American lizards, also generously share his breeding secrets How to distinguish male and female South American lizards? How to keep them healthy? What's the secret to taming them? In this epsiode, we unpack the living environment of South American lizards and reveal the breeding guide!

programme.desc: Genus Pterophyllum, commonly known as P scalare, freshwater angelfish or just angelfish is a large tropical fish native to the Amazon River in South AmericaThey have a laterally flattened body, making them suitableto live in the crevices of tree roots in rivers with smooth water flow, and feeds on aquatic insects The water temperature should be maintained at 26℃, and should reach 27-28℃ when breeding The fertilized eggs are then released and attached to water plants or rocks, and the couple will take care of them together However, once the eggs are hatched, the bigger ones will eat the smaller ones, hence not suitable to be raised together with other small fishes

programme.title: 如果還有明天
programme.desc: 今天,有很多人正面對著生命中突然而至的苦難與罪困,在天災、人禍、病困及罪咎中,有人因為痛苦不堪而選擇輕生,但亦都有人在掙扎過後,生命變得更有焦點,更清晰人生的方向。影音使團製作隊跨越中港台兩地,拍攝對象包括:台灣風災救災者、飽歷風霜的一代影星、蒙古車禍生還者、從死亡邊緣活過來的反派演員、與癌同行的歷

programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地

programme.title: 如果還有明天
programme.desc: 今天,有很多人正面對著生命中突然而至的苦難與罪困,在天災、人禍、病困及罪咎中,有人因為痛苦不堪而選擇輕生,但亦都有人在掙扎過後,生命變得更有焦點,更清晰人生的方向。影音使團製作隊跨越中港台兩地,拍攝對象包括:台灣風災救災者、飽歷風霜的一代影星、蒙古車禍生還者、從死亡邊緣活過來的反派演員、與癌同行的歷

programme.title: 主日講壇-基督之家第五家
programme.desc: 基督之家第五家 講題:如鷹 人每一天都要面對很多抉擇,要將上帝的智慧應用在生活不同層面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧師和傳道人的講道中,往往都能夠得到啟迪。透過主日講壇,更明白神的道並在生活中尋求到神喜悅的心意。

programme.title: 屬靈教室: 程蒙恩長老-初信成長2
programme.desc: 在你接受耶穌那一刻,一個新生命已經在你裡面誕生。你瞭解這個新生命的身份和地位嗎?你希望過上嶄新的生活嗎?你渴望更認識上帝和聖經嗎?就讓程蒙恩長老和你一起走上這條信徒成長之路。

programme.title: 來!為這城禱告
programme.desc: 你們要為那城求平安,為那城禱告耶和華;因為那城得平安,你們也隨著得平安。(耶29:7)

programme.title: 《天下華人唱出好詩歌大賽》大賽
programme.desc: 由影音使團、香港福音盛會、華福會香港區委會、以勒基金主辦,創世電視首屆「天下華人唱出好詩歌」大賽,冠軍即將誕生。世上最美的聲音,是生命重生的聲音,世上最美的身影,是逆境前行的身影。500位參加者,一年訓練、成長、比併、同行,要成為祝福城市的好聲音。

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室
programme.desc: 主持小金子喬媽,人稱「喜樂婆婆」,一生經歷操練出一套喜樂心得,她更請來一眾嘉賓好友,分享人生中大小風浪,靠著的是同出一轍的喜樂秘訣,在節目中娓娓道出那份屬天的快樂。

programme.title: 地球深度行V 大地的寶藏
programme.desc: 攝製隊走訪美國、英國、 瑞士、澳洲、土耳其、以色列、埃及、中國及亞洲等國家,訪尋學者專家多年來從大地發掘的寶藏及科研成果,當中包括高山上經歷大洪水形成的奇異化石;全球首卷手抄絲綢中文聖經;以色列鑄造挪亞方舟金幣場等。n一切一切的資料,讓觀眾在欣賞地球的創造同時,見證上帝的奇妙創作及精密設計,從心感受

programme.title: 主日講壇-中國基督教播道會同福堂
programme.desc: 中國基督教播道會同福堂 講題:我們的雲柱火柱 人每一天都要面對很多抉擇,要將上帝的智慧應用在生活不同層面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧師和傳道人的講道中,往往都能夠得到啟迪。透過主日講壇,更明白神的道並在生活中尋求到神喜悅的心意。

programme.title: 靈修早晨
programme.desc: 每天早晨透過詩歌安靜心靈,從牧者及嘉賓的分享學習《聖經》中的真理,讓觀眾由淺入深認識信仰,默想《聖經》教導。

programme.title: 來!為這城禱告
programme.desc: 你們要為那城求平安,為那城禱告耶和華;因為那城得平安,你們也隨著得平安。(耶29:7)

programme.title: 地球深度行IV 鐵証待判
programme.desc: 《地球深度行4之鐵證待判》繼續以遊歷的方式,走進荷蘭、土耳其、約旦、敍利亞,涉及接近50個地點,超過30個已經發生嘅神蹟預言、傳奇故事,以考古和實證,重新解構連科學都不能解釋的千古謎團。 歷年來有無數的考古學家和世界知名的紀錄片頻道,為瞭解開上帝藉著摩西施行神蹟分割紅海這個歷史迷團,他們都不惜花上大

programme.title: 福氣教會講道系列
programme.desc: 如何建立健康強盛的教會? 改變社區可以轉化城市? 作為基督徒,我們又如何盡忠地完成普世宣教使命? 一個「幸福小組」,讓教會續步履行三個使命!由台灣高雄福氣教會牧者主講,從《聖經》的話語開始,一起來學習「幸福」智慧!

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
高朋滿座#139粵
programme.desc: 洛向悅示愛，朋緊張，悅卻沾沾自喜。洛成為朋學生，因洛要觀察朋是否稱職丈夫。據洛觀察，朋懦弱配不上悅，而洛更揚言要全力追求悅。朋大驚向家人求助，眾人於是想出要悅假扮精神分裂來嚇走洛，可惜洛竟不離不棄。

programme.title: 命轉皇后#14粵普PG
programme.desc: 薛姝令秦貴妃滑胎的計謀因雪蕙而事敗，姚惜成替罪羊被貶出宮；謝危向聖上呈上燕家印信，提議將燕牧父子流放璜州，張遮認為謝危其心不正；雪寧在雪夜找謝危問清楚，不料目睹謝危離魂症發作殺公儀丞，謝危向雪寧舉刀…

programme.title: 交易現場粵 及 卓正醫療呈獻：全家健康攻略粵
食平DD粵
programme.desc: 肥媽發掘豬的內在美。原來白醋和腐皮對胡椒豬肚湯有畫龍點睛的作用。以西式食材炮製燜豬脷，有何驚喜？四十多元買豬膶，就煮到接近十人份量的豬膶麵，符合食平D精神。煮西米是椰汁椰糖西米糕的關鍵，怎樣煮才合格？

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 熬夜會導致「爆血管」？腦科醫生指長期熬夜令血壓難以下降，增加中風與腦血管疾病的風險。醫生提醒如出現突發的嚴重頭痛，要盡快求醫。她亦帶來熬夜後的補救方法，以及預防中風的建議。蓋鳴暉將與內地名伶李淑勤合演粵劇戲寶《帝女花》，兩位大老倌合作於一杯咖啡的時間內促成？她細談籌備點滴，並回顧近四十年的舞台生涯。她自揭本想當花旦，為求入行才任文武生。「睇餸食飯」環節，陳國賓示範「涼拌牛油果煎小青椒」，清爽開胃。

programme.title: 大灣區美味好玩攻略粵
programme.desc: 郭柏姸再次前來跟美儀、麥包吃喝玩樂，還帶上好姊妹羅毓儀一同遊開平。馬降龍碉樓、赤坎古鎮皆充滿古舊氣息，吸引大家瘋狂打卡。古鎮內的特色酒店設計雅致，感覺舒適。古鎮入夜後還會舉行不少表演，配合光影效果，讓人目不暇給。享用全鵝宴，把鵝蛋先蒸後炸的菜式，口感有驚喜。遊覽由舊村落活化而成的文化區，行逛糧倉改建的書店，下榻民宿，並品嚐以柴火烹調的美食。台山的黃鱔飯遠近馳名，再用鱔骨煮湯，大家吃得甚是滿足。

programme.title: 東坡家事#1粵PG
programme.desc: 蘇東坡帶堂姨仔王閏之到潤州找尋美食，認識韓元。閏之暗示要嫁東坡，東坡因思念亡妻不敢有非份之想。蘇小妹誤闖擂台被予婚書，小妹堅拒不嫁。壽安郡主為報復藉柳月娥之口逼閏之嫁韓元；閏之為保東坡，答允嫁韓元……

programme.title: 科學×冒險 絕境求生手冊粵日

programme.desc: 力蓮欲與Ceci洽談某食品的獨家代理權，卻接連被雷公搶佔先機。她向敢威提出證據，懷疑璟風吃裡扒外協助雷公，璟風縱解釋，敢威卻不信。為要取回敢威的信任，並避免尋寶圖有所損失，璟風決意要從雷公手上取得食品的代理權。璟風找力蓮洽談代理權之事，力蓮卻拒絕合作，並提到敢威授意奪得代理權之人可成為尋寶圖話事人，她揚言要奪回尋寶圖，更透露真正目的……璟風決不可讓力蓮得逞，與若水等全力爭取代理權，卻遇到阻滯……

programme.title: 森下仁丹Bifina Si 益生菌呈獻：非份之罪#12粵PG
programme.desc: 紹聰生前立了信託基金，悅萍可合法繼承大屋業權，惟條件是要待淑嫻與宏智離世後才可全權擁有。淑嫻認定是悅萍殺害紹聰，還想將罪名嫁禍，甚不服氣。帶弟亦開始認同淑嫻所想，於是聯手調查悅萍，另邊廂，警方亦開始將調查方向移往悅萍……淑嫻憑蛛絲馬跡找到悅萍住處，欲帶走宏智，怎料悅萍說出一個現況，令宏智決定留下陪伴悅萍。警方查到越來越多罪證，帶悅萍及宏智返警署協助調查，悅萍錄口供時，宏智突然心臟病發作……

programme.title: 食玩假期呈獻：江湖見粵
programme.desc: 武當山於武俠小說之中，是一個「武林聖地」。當年有明成祖朱棣登山欲拜見張三丰，這次有黎耀祥、麥包上來參觀，卻發覺與想像之中有大不同？拍攝時剛好遇着下雪，眼前雪景顯得特別豐富，只因植物種類多？小說內，各派武林人士集結於金頂，麥包卻發現被小說「騙」了，既要不斷爬梯級登上海拔一千六百米山峰，而且頂處僅有幾百呎面積！還是到皇家級建築群紫霄宮，悠然賞覧，再跟三丰派的掌門人見個面，化身張無忌耍太極，隨心寫意。

programme.title: 女法醫解密#22粵普PG
programme.desc: 秦莞找李牧雲理論，懷疑其為天道社成員。燕澤囚禁燕涵，燕離闖入後被刺傷；燕涵殺死燕澤後毒發身亡，臨終悔罪。另一方面，皇后與素貴妃發生衝突並同歸於盡。太后自責，決定傳位燕綏，請燕遲輔佐，並頒佈一連串新法…

programme.desc: （大結局）戚幹中槍入院，大偉不顧劉Sir阻止，到醫院探病，但見父親昏迷不醒，不禁悽然。劉Sir使計挑撥陳水與一帆，令陳水出庭指證一帆；又用心理壓力使傑與警方合作，指證崔福。一帆窮途末路，詐病入院藉機逃走，但久候船未見，與張錦一起藏身郊區，但卒被劉Sir之「射鷹」行動拘捕。戚幹奮勇救子，令同袍欽佩，大偉亦因努力於職務同獲上級讚賞，被賜予獎狀，大偉深感父親捨身救己，遂將奬狀轉贈父親，以表心意。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 心臟早搏，是指心房或心室出現自發性的不規律跳動，要長時間持續監控心率以作診斷。至於心房顫動，即心跳受體內電波干擾而錯亂，如嚴重會引發心臟衰竭，心臟科醫生講述可根治顫動的「導管消融手術」細節。導演王晶的女兒王海榛近期轉戰司儀界，為何有此決定？她亦活躍經營社交平台，相反，晶哥宣佈要暫停更新網上頻道，消息令人關注。海榛透露父親近況，也大揭晶哥私底下的一面。「睇餸食飯」，李振龍師傅奉上「夠薑米酒雞」。

programme.title: 大灣區美味好玩攻略粵PG
programme.desc: 江門新會的陳皮價值不菲，來到當地，美儀教柏姸、毓儀以陳皮養生，怎料孖妹想出用陳皮當作湯匙吃雪糕？她們亦會品嚐多款新派陳皮美點。歎大餐時，孖妹亂猜多道菜的由來，場面惹笑；美儀更稱要讓麥包「食軟飯」？麥包帶大家訪尋「糯米雞」，揭蓋後賣相超乎想像，吃進口中的糯米還滲出芋頭香氣。一探結合老舊建築的隱世咖啡店；再於專門店享用肥美台山蠔，配以檸檬葉、芝士等驚喜連連。行逛文化園區，孖妹更換上旗袍，提前迎新春。

programme.title: 東坡家事#2粵PG
programme.desc: 秦少游在末法寺遇小妹，邀她對句但小妹未能接下，遂要求小妹提問東坡。東坡發現製作假交子工場後被捉，太君要他同流合污。成婚當日，閏之見東坡等人被扣押，竟以髮簪脅持韓元……回京後，閏之發現廚房給嬌姐搶去……

programme.title: 高朋滿座#140粵
programme.desc: 大廈出現「偷鞋怪賊」，將放在門外所有鞋偷去。眾人發現慶家中的按摩椅被搬到朋家後，欲搶先享受，麗想出以做些有利高家事情的人才可用按摩椅，而義、情及溢亦樂意參加。義及溢努力做家務，令情失去享用的機會。

programme.title: 命轉皇后#15粵普PG
programme.desc: 雪寧憑觀察推斷出謝危乃假身分，謝危不置可否。薛定非奉平南王之命攜燕牧的下半封信入京，豈料信被公儀丞部下偷走。雪寧故意把燕臨送的琴變賣以便籌錢讓周寅之跟逆黨換信，以此引起謝危注意，並借謝危之手杜絕後患。

programme.title: 我係小廚神3粵
programme.desc: Cindy與Cyrus隨麥美恩及肥仔到台中，參觀農地及種菇基地，鴨子亦可擔任農夫？即摘即食花刺身，Cyrus卻有所堅持！考驗來了，他們要以阿薩姆紅茶製出創意紅茶蛋糕，大家還看到Cyrus與Cindy待人接物的大不同。在港的小廚神學包蝦餃及造型鳳梨酥，袁文傑只看不吃，選出最佳視藝作品。徐菁遙指導各人炮製梳乎厘，小廚神們加點創意，做出七彩繽紛的甜品，有人竟以亂七八糟為題做甜品，不怕被批評嗎？

高朋滿座#141粵
programme.desc: 朋指責眾人飯前吃太多零食，引致剩下飯菜過多，眾人愛理不理，妙喜更提議將吃剩的食物當禮物送給根。慶發起「罷吃罐頭食物」行動，妙喜下令要根購買飯盒。根將朋所送他的飯菜當飯盒給眾人吃，眾人竟大表讚賞。

programme.title: 命轉皇后#16粵普PG
programme.desc: 燕家流放之日突然提前，姜雪寧趕往大牢與燕臨道別，卻碰上前來劫獄的黃潛等人，姜雪寧趁亂逃跑時竟遇到身穿囚衣的張遮。黃潛等人被圍困，張遮自稱度鈞山人並帶他們逃到城外，可是平南王黨羽仍對他的身分存疑…

食平DD粵
programme.desc: 今集肥媽準備全鴨宴。肥媽竟然用到香橙煮鴨，會變出甚麼神奇效果？她特別加入八角、大辣椒調味煮台式鴨舌，有何特別作用？烹調冬菇燜鴨腳有甚麼貼士？肥媽傳授只用普通家庭鑊，就可以炮製出香軟的免焗梳乎厘。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 如頸部出現腫脹，可能與甲亢或甲減有關，這類疾病卻不會演變成癌症。臨床腫瘤科醫生指女性患甲狀腺癌的風險較高，若及早發現，仍可藉手術切除根治。此外，醫生亦詳述利用放射碘作治療的資訊。五歲以上兒童如一星期內發生兩次或以上尿床，且情況持續，中醫學就診斷為「小兒遺尿」，並與腎、脾、肺功能失調有關。醫師細談小兒遺尿的不同證型，也會介紹合適的食療湯水。「睇餸食飯」，有Kobe鄭紫欣亮相，帶來「醬香肉碎豆腐飯」。

programme.title: 大灣區美味好玩攻略粵
programme.desc: 這回「灣區遊」目的地是中山，黃嘉雯跟團隨行，先要「服待」兩位前輩圍爐煮茶？薄餅用菊花作餡料，味道如何？參觀紅博城，紅木傢俱讓主持們眼界大開。入夜後行逛中山路步行街，米花糖勾起麥包的兒時回憶。一魚多吃，吃盡中山名物脆肉鯇的不同滋味；用餐期間，嘉雯卻「得罪」前輩？遊覽土樓品嚐客家菜，麥包大讚是傳統滋味。石岐乳鴿遠近馳名，麥包、嘉雯落手大快朵頤，撕開呈現豐沛肉汁。前往新派酒吧小酌，嘉雯竟有「浪漫」要求？

programme.title: 東坡家事#3粵
programme.desc: 閏之與嬌姐同時煮出羊腩煲，嬌姐手藝獲大讚。東坡要兩人比試，敗者須入宮當廚娘。比賽時，閏之煮的豬肉味道偏甜，明白鹽被換成糖。東坡邀皇上到酒樓試菜，因皇上對紅燒豬肉讚賞，百姓轉食豬肉。閏之終如願嫁予東坡。

programme.title: 科學×冒險 絕境求生手冊粵日
programme.desc: 參加叢林探險營的大部份人都感染了新型病毒。為尋找救援，智悟、皮皮與凱伊來到村落，但村落竟空無一人，實情是他們都被直升機救走了。此時的叢林已被指定為隔離區，因此，智悟三人又要展開逃生之旅。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 粵劇是傳統藝術，要讓它接觸更廣觀眾群，年輕化及加入地方元素是其中方法。有劇團主席致力推動粵劇文化，也透過慈善團體研究港式粵劇於當代的發展與傳承，將傳統劇目融入潮流新意，她於「Kids’ Notes」細說箇中想法。創新之餘都要學習傳統基礎，嘉賓示範粵劇步法、造手、使用水袖等技巧，並講述化妝竅門與樂隊資訊。為了吸引青年觀眾，團體曾舉辦粵劇宣傳大使等活動，有何特色？小朋友首次接觸粵劇，又有甚麼劇目推介？

programme.title: 忍者亂太郎粵日
programme.desc: 拔天坊的事件，在高年級生的努力下，查明了幕後黑手的身份。安藤老師與厚着老師，對於一甲班的教育方針，因意見不合而發生爭執。亂太郎小丸新丁一起玩，但小丸與新丁因為不滿亂太郎毫不留手而憤怒。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2851粵 及 保誠精選「寵愛寶」呈獻：社畜求生101粵
programme.desc: 蔥頭因牙斬斬滯留吳旺達，Bonnie獲城安告知原因，得悉牙斬斬對她鍾情，決意前赴吳旺達救人，卻無法入境。城安想到令牙斬斬放棄Bonnie之法，方法原本奏效，但最終卻功虧一簣。另一方面，牙斬斬按吳旺達習俗求愛，曾向Bonnie發射吹箭，但因城安阻止而射失。城安、凌凌等得知吹箭誤中李莫仇，遂打算撮合她與牙斬斬，卻事與願違。城安想到一個解決方法，為達到目的卻要作出犧牲……

programme.title: 森下仁丹Bifina Si 益生菌呈獻：非份之罪#13粵PG
programme.desc: 宏智突然向警方自首殺死紹聰，淑嫻、帶弟以及警方都知事實非如此，但供詞幾乎沒有破綻……淑嫻想用錢收買悅萍教宏智改口供，卻只換來侮辱。淑嫻愛子心切，向警方自認是兇手！帶弟苦尋證據，試圖向警方證明淑嫻清白。悅萍本想在繼承張家大宅後，將淑嫻和帶弟迫走，卻令帶弟在執拾物件的過程中有所發現，有可能扭轉局面……

programme.title: 食玩假期呈獻：江湖見粵
programme.desc: 龍門石窟是洛陽的地標景點，師兄弟遊覽此地，參拜逾十七米高的大佛，相傳其造型跟女帝武則天有關。大詩人白居易自號「香山居士」，所指的香山就與龍門鄰近，兩主持漫步其中，感受文雅氣息。登上在原址重建的唐代建築，在應天門體驗女帝當年登基的風采，再到附近的明堂，黎耀祥換上帝服「登基」，又讚嘆古人的建築智慧。洛陽水席的歷史據說可追溯至唐朝，以蘿蔔充當燕窩的牡丹燕菜曾被周恩來用作招待外賓；焦炸丸子，則香脆可口。

programme.title: 不眠日#1粵普PG
programme.desc: 七年前，丁奇偶然墮進24小時的循環，而且只有自己的記憶不會消失；每個循環日只會循環五次，亦無法預知下次何時來臨。他因而贏盡錢財，卻感不快樂，便想利用它做更有意義的事而投考警察，展開與別不同的警察生涯…

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 卓正醫療呈獻：全家健康攻略粵
再創世紀#1粵PG
programme.desc: 傲堂集團太子女卓定垚在布拉格街頭跳舞賣藝，遇搶劫幸好有賀天生幫忙，天生隨後希望定垚為他勸一位畫家割愛。傲堂集團證券部主管高哲飛往溫哥華找女友鄭思妤相聚，笑談結婚計劃。公司面臨危機的天生認為只要香港有一巨人倒下，便是他賺大錢的好時機，還即時向同道中人章明晞求婚。高哲向傲堂集團創辦人卓啟堂表示看淡後市，應減省開支做好儲備。天生查到香港首富方松蔭之子方孝聰大量買入累計期權，伺機以商業手段吞併首富資產。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 如頸部出現腫脹，可能與甲亢或甲減有關，這類疾病卻不會演變成癌症。臨床腫瘤科醫生指女性患甲狀腺癌的風險較高，若及早發現，仍可藉手術切除根治。此外，醫生亦詳述利用放射碘作治療的資訊。五歲以上兒童如一星期內發生兩次或以上尿床，且情況持續，中醫學就診斷為「小兒遺尿」，並與腎、脾、肺功能失調有關。醫師細談小兒遺尿的不同證型，也會介紹合適的食療湯水。「睇餸食飯」，有Kobe鄭紫欣亮相，帶來「醬香肉碎豆腐飯」。

programme.title: 大灣區美味好玩攻略粵
programme.desc: 這回「灣區遊」目的地是中山，黃嘉雯跟團隨行，先要「服待」兩位前輩圍爐煮茶？薄餅用菊花作餡料，味道如何？參觀紅博城，紅木傢俱讓主持們眼界大開。入夜後行逛中山路步行街，米花糖勾起麥包的兒時回憶。一魚多吃，吃盡中山名物脆肉鯇的不同滋味；用餐期間，嘉雯卻「得罪」前輩？遊覽土樓品嚐客家菜，麥包大讚是傳統滋味。石岐乳鴿遠近馳名，麥包、嘉雯落手大快朵頤，撕開呈現豐沛肉汁。前往新派酒吧小酌，嘉雯竟有「浪漫」要求？

programme.title: 東坡家事#3粵
programme.desc: 閏之與嬌姐同時煮出羊腩煲，嬌姐手藝獲大讚。東坡要兩人比試，敗者須入宮當廚娘。比賽時，閏之煮的豬肉味道偏甜，明白鹽被換成糖。東坡邀皇上到酒樓試菜，因皇上對紅燒豬肉讚賞，百姓轉食豬肉。閏之終如願嫁予東坡。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#141粵
programme.desc: 朋指責眾人飯前吃太多零食，引致剩下飯菜過多，眾人愛理不理，妙喜更提議將吃剩的食物當禮物送給根。慶發起「罷吃罐頭食物」行動，妙喜下令要根購買飯盒。根將朋所送他的飯菜當飯盒給眾人吃，眾人竟大表讚賞。

programme.title: 命轉皇后#16粵普PG
programme.desc: 燕家流放之日突然提前，姜雪寧趕往大牢與燕臨道別，卻碰上前來劫獄的黃潛等人，姜雪寧趁亂逃跑時竟遇到身穿囚衣的張遮。黃潛等人被圍困，張遮自稱度鈞山人並帶他們逃到城外，可是平南王黨羽仍對他的身分存疑…

programme.title: Sunday靚聲王粵
programme.desc: Joe Junior、Anders Nelsson、Christine Samson、D’ topnotes、張武孝、蘇姍、苗可秀、胡蓓蔚、羅孝勇、譚嘉儀，中英歌詞「撈埋」唱，演繹早年的西歐流行歌曲！

programme.desc: 單純直率的豆小鴨總是不小心闖禍，還好他有最棒的好朋友－－善解人意的袋熊沃蓓，和熱愛發明的小豬奇姆！只要三個人在一起，不管遇到任何困難，都能運用創意找到有趣的方法解決，把日常生活的所有危機，變成精彩好玩的大冒險！快快快，一起來山谷洞玩吧！

programme.title: 我親愛的朋友們
programme.desc: 【老人也有春天！七十歲的我們 終於學會說不】她們是一群走過風雨的老人，曾為家庭默默奉獻，如今選擇為自己綻放。一場聚會重新牽起年少情誼，也掀開多年壓抑的心事。有人鼓起勇氣離婚，搬進夢想中的小屋；有人在意外後學會面對過錯，重拾友情的信任；有人對抗失智，卻仍記得朋友的名字與笑聲。女兒朴莞在傾聽中理解母親，在書寫中記錄她們的光芒。人生未晚，她們手牽著手，用皺紋寫下溫柔，也用笑聲走向嶄新的旅程。

programme.title: 好搭檔
programme.desc: 【張娜拉火力全開！槓上小三、手撕出軌老公超過癮】王牌律師遇上菜鳥新人，一場法庭與情感的雙重對決即將展開！《好搭檔》講述擁有17年經驗的離婚律師車恩京，在面對丈夫背叛後，與熱血正義的新人韓宥利成為「最不可能搭檔」的辦公室火花組合。冷面魔頭與理想主義者，兩人從互看不順眼，到聯手應對一樁樁離婚官司，解開婚姻背後的人性兩難。冷靜與熱血交織，掀起一場場心碎又痛快的離婚風暴！

programme.title: 燦爛的遺產
programme.desc: 【李昇基、韓孝珠經典代表作！灰姑娘逆襲無賴王子】高恩星在母親因病去世後，從此多了一個沒有血緣關係的妹妹柳承美。繼母城府極深，表面上對恩星姐弟關愛有加，但卻是個非常愛錢的女人。恩星的父親公司破產，且不慎遭搶劫，搶匪戴著他的物品在火災中喪生。繼母誤認死者為丈夫，領取巨額保險金後將恩星姊弟趕出門。恩星偶然救了食品公司社長張淑子，而得到工作，然而張淑子竟然說要把財產全留給恩星，還說要切斷金孫于煥所有的經濟來源。為了逆轉這種情況，于煥只好跟仇人般的恩星一起工作，卻發現自己逐漸喜歡上恩星。

programme.title: 不像三兄弟
programme.desc: 【李浚赫化身金家小兒子婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！】聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女。兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫。笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚、不折不撓的品性。宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己。後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業。

programme.title: 壞記憶橡皮擦
programme.desc: 【金在中攜陳世娫出演新劇《壞記憶橡皮擦》回歸電視劇！！】曾是被看好的網球之星李君，在負傷之後喪失了自尊心，認為自己從人生的主角變成配角。遇上腦研究中心的醫生景珠妍，使用了記憶橡皮擦抹去了過去記憶，重生為運動經紀人，而景珠妍也意外成了他的初戀。因被篡改的記憶開始的羅曼史，在得知真相后其結局將會如何呢？

programme.title: 女神降臨
programme.desc: 【人氣漫畫改編，車銀優搭文佳煐神還原廣受好評！！】國中時因長相不起眼飽受霸凌的任朱靜，掌握化妝技巧後上妝搖身一變成為校園女神。與隱藏著不為人知傷痛的校園男神李修豪及個性直率講義氣的韓書俊，三角戀情一觸即發的一起面對著戀愛、生活帶來的的青春浪漫喜劇。

programme.title: 風起西州
programme.desc: 【《風起霓裳》最新續作！！許魏洲、古力娜扎續夫妻情緣，琴瑟和鳴的婚後生活及事業新考驗！！】製衣才女庫狄琉璃與裴行儉婚後面對大長公主的屢次使計刁難，琉璃聰慧應對，化險為夷。裴行儉因意外被貶遠赴西州上任，夫妻攜手同心，琉璃發揮自己的長才，傳授西州百姓製衣技巧。裴行儉則守護西州百姓經濟富足、安居樂業。

programme.title: 壞記憶橡皮擦

programme.title: 戀人的謊言
programme.desc: 舒菲和林菲從小一起長大，姐妹情深，形影不離，在大學期間英年才俊奇然學長喜歡林菲，但林菲對奇然沒有感覺，暗戀奇然的舒菲借用林菲的名字和奇然書信來往，姐妹兩同時進入購物電視台上班，意外發現自己的上司居然是奇然，奇然依然鍾情林菲，舒菲暗戀心情破碎，心思放工作上，偶然結識導演藍天，兩人互生情愫，而林菲職場失意，又得知舒菲當年利用她的名字和奇然書信來往，於是陷害舒菲泄露商業機密，害公司倒閉，舒菲陷入輿論壓力中，藍天陪在舒菲身邊，拆穿林菲的謊言，最後林菲真心悔過，和舒菲和好如初，舒菲也收穫和愛情和事業。

programme.desc: 舒菲和林菲從小一起長大，姐妹情深，形影不離，在大學期間英年才俊奇然學長喜歡林菲，但林菲對奇然沒有感覺，暗戀奇然的舒菲借用林菲的名字和奇然書信來往，姐妹兩同時進入購物電視台上班，意外發現自己的上司居然是奇然，奇然依然鍾情林菲，舒菲暗戀心情破碎，心思放工作上，偶然結識導演藍天，兩人互生情愫，而林菲職場失意，又得知舒菲當年利用她的名字和奇然書信來往，於是陷害舒菲泄露商業機密，害公司倒閉，舒菲陷入輿論壓力中，藍天陪在舒菲身邊，拆穿林菲的謊言，最後林菲真心悔過，和舒菲和好如初，舒菲也收穫和愛情和事業。

programme.title: 女神降臨
programme.desc: 【人氣漫畫改編，車銀優搭文佳煐神還原廣受好評！！】國中時因長相不起眼飽受霸凌的任朱靜，掌握化妝技巧後上妝搖身一變成為校園女神。與隱藏著不為人知傷痛的校園男神李修豪及個性直率講義氣的韓書俊，三角戀情一觸即發的一起面對著戀愛、生活帶來的的青春浪漫喜劇。

programme.title: 我親愛的朋友們
programme.desc: 【老人也有春天！七十歲的我們 終於學會說不】她們是一群走過風雨的老人，曾為家庭默默奉獻，如今選擇為自己綻放。一場聚會重新牽起年少情誼，也掀開多年壓抑的心事。有人鼓起勇氣離婚，搬進夢想中的小屋；有人在意外後學會面對過錯，重拾友情的信任；有人對抗失智，卻仍記得朋友的名字與笑聲。女兒朴莞在傾聽中理解母親，在書寫中記錄她們的光芒。人生未晚，她們手牽著手，用皺紋寫下溫柔，也用笑聲走向嶄新的旅程。

programme.title: 好搭檔
programme.desc: 【張娜拉火力全開！槓上小三、手撕出軌老公超過癮】王牌律師遇上菜鳥新人，一場法庭與情感的雙重對決即將展開！《好搭檔》講述擁有17年經驗的離婚律師車恩京，在面對丈夫背叛後，與熱血正義的新人韓宥利成為「最不可能搭檔」的辦公室火花組合。冷面魔頭與理想主義者，兩人從互看不順眼，到聯手應對一樁樁離婚官司，解開婚姻背後的人性兩難。冷靜與熱血交織，掀起一場場心碎又痛快的離婚風暴！

programme.title: 燦爛的遺產
programme.desc: 【李昇基、韓孝珠經典代表作！灰姑娘逆襲無賴王子】高恩星在母親因病去世後，從此多了一個沒有血緣關係的妹妹柳承美。繼母城府極深，表面上對恩星姐弟關愛有加，但卻是個非常愛錢的女人。恩星的父親公司破產，且不慎遭搶劫，搶匪戴著他的物品在火災中喪生。繼母誤認死者為丈夫，領取巨額保險金後將恩星姊弟趕出門。恩星偶然救了食品公司社長張淑子，而得到工作，然而張淑子竟然說要把財產全留給恩星，還說要切斷金孫于煥所有的經濟來源。為了逆轉這種情況，于煥只好跟仇人般的恩星一起工作，卻發現自己逐漸喜歡上恩星。

programme.title: 不像三兄弟
programme.desc: 【李浚赫化身金家小兒子婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！】聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女。兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫。笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚、不折不撓的品性。宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己。後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業。

programme.title: 我親愛的朋友們
programme.desc: 【老人也有春天！七十歲的我們 終於學會說不】她們是一群走過風雨的老人，曾為家庭默默奉獻，如今選擇為自己綻放。一場聚會重新牽起年少情誼，也掀開多年壓抑的心事。有人鼓起勇氣離婚，搬進夢想中的小屋；有人在意外後學會面對過錯，重拾友情的信任；有人對抗失智，卻仍記得朋友的名字與笑聲。女兒朴莞在傾聽中理解母親，在書寫中記錄她們的光芒。人生未晚，她們手牽著手，用皺紋寫下溫柔，也用笑聲走向嶄新的旅程。

programme.title: 壞記憶橡皮擦
programme.desc: 【金在中攜陳世娫出演新劇《壞記憶橡皮擦》回歸電視劇！！】曾是被看好的網球之星李君，在負傷之後喪失了自尊心，認為自己從人生的主角變成配角。遇上腦研究中心的醫生景珠妍，使用了記憶橡皮擦抹去了過去記憶，重生為運動經紀人，而景珠妍也意外成了他的初戀。因被篡改的記憶開始的羅曼史，在得知真相后其結局將會如何呢？

programme.title: 女神降臨
programme.desc: 【人氣漫畫改編，車銀優搭文佳煐神還原廣受好評！！】國中時因長相不起眼飽受霸凌的任朱靜，掌握化妝技巧後上妝搖身一變成為校園女神。與隱藏著不為人知傷痛的校園男神李修豪及個性直率講義氣的韓書俊，三角戀情一觸即發的一起面對著戀愛、生活帶來的的青春浪漫喜劇。

programme.title: 風起西州
programme.desc: 【《風起霓裳》最新續作！！許魏洲、古力娜扎續夫妻情緣，琴瑟和鳴的婚後生活及事業新考驗！！】製衣才女庫狄琉璃與裴行儉婚後面對大長公主的屢次使計刁難，琉璃聰慧應對，化險為夷。裴行儉因意外被貶遠赴西州上任，夫妻攜手同心，琉璃發揮自己的長才，傳授西州百姓製衣技巧。裴行儉則守護西州百姓經濟富足、安居樂業。

programme.title: 壞記憶橡皮擦

programme.title: 戀人的謊言
programme.desc: 舒菲和林菲從小一起長大，姐妹情深，形影不離，在大學期間英年才俊奇然學長喜歡林菲，但林菲對奇然沒有感覺，暗戀奇然的舒菲借用林菲的名字和奇然書信來往，姐妹兩同時進入購物電視台上班，意外發現自己的上司居然是奇然，奇然依然鍾情林菲，舒菲暗戀心情破碎，心思放工作上，偶然結識導演藍天，兩人互生情愫，而林菲職場失意，又得知舒菲當年利用她的名字和奇然書信來往，於是陷害舒菲泄露商業機密，害公司倒閉，舒菲陷入輿論壓力中，藍天陪在舒菲身邊，拆穿林菲的謊言，最後林菲真心悔過，和舒菲和好如初，舒菲也收穫和愛情和事業。

La patrulla de antimateria entra en contacto con el cloro y les propone proporcionarles rifles para dominar al sodio y así obligarlos a molecularizarse, pero Chip se burla de la antimateria y logra que el cloro y el sodio dejen de ser enemigos, restableciendo la paz en el mundo submarino.

Pero cuando el viento amaina, Chip idea una estrategia y deja a la antimateria encerrada en el molino, mientras él y los átomos siguen adelante.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - QUACK-QUACK - SUPERJUMP! ROOKIE AND THE FROG
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting by a pond when he suddenly sees eyes staring at him from the water. Thinking of his friend the crocodile, he first keeps a safe distance, but then realizes that it is a cool frog that jumps out of the water and performs some awesome tricks. Rookie watches and tries to copy, and it doesn’t take too long to master such leaps, the frog being an excellent teacher. And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FLY, ROOKIE FLY! ROOKIE AND THE BIRD
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn‘t give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow’s nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown’s face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - DANCE WITH YOUR FRIENDS – ROOKIE THE DJ
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FRIENDS IN THE SKY, FRIENDS FLYING HIGH? ROOKIE AND THE CLOUDS
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What‘s that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - El castillo de Robins
programme.desc: Como la lente no se puede recuperar, el Dr. No quiere fabricar otra, pero necesita petirrojos para ello. Así que ataca Rubidia, una región repleta de piedras preciosas. Pero Oxin, el rey de Rubidia, lo toma prisionero y lo encierra en el castillo donde también está Chip, ya que Oxin los obliga a trabajar como esclavos en sus minas. El Dr. No intenta convencer a Chip de que le devuelva la lente, pero Chip se niega. Más tarde, ambos logran escapar del castillo y el Dr. No persigue a Chip con su nave. Pero el chico atrapa al científico y también ayuda a liberar a los esclavos de Rubidia.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - La trampa de la armonica
programme.desc: Chip y sus amigos crean una zona con formaciones que se asemejan a instrumentos musicales y armonizan sus sonidos. De repente, quedan atrapados en un rectángulo de cristales de cuarzo que vibran al formar una trampa sónica. Un átomo músico, que los ha capturado, busca miembros para formar una orquesta. programme.title: Wild Japan S01 - Honshu
programme.desc: The central island of Honshu is home to over 100 million people, and its biggest city, Tokyo, is one of the largest urban metropolises on earth. But it has a wild heart - most of Honshu is mountainous. This wilderness is home to an astonishing range of wildlife - black bears, monkeys, exquisite fireflies and even cow demons. But all across this island, from the mountains to the edge of the sea, people and nature are drawn together in the most unexpected ways.

programme.title: Amazing Railway Adventures with Nick Knowles S02 - Morocco
programme.desc: Nick's train leaves from Tangier and it's a special one; AL Boraq, which speeds along the high-speed line making its way down the west coast. At its fastest Al Boraq reaches nearly 200 mph and is run entirely on wind power. The ambition is to run Morocco's entire railway system on green energy within the next two years.

programme.title: Earth S01 - Atmosphere

programme.title: Playtime Towers S01 - Tubes

programme.title: Go Jetters S01 - Tarbela Dam, Pakistan
programme.desc: A G.O. Force is missing! The good news is that Jetpad has located it at the Tarbela Dam in Pakistan, but the bad news is that it's in the not so capable hands of Grandmaster Glitch. The Go Jetters speed off to get the click on back, but it's out of control -firing all kinds of weather, and Grandmaster Glitch doesn't know how to turn it off. As lightning strikes the Dam, threatening to flood the valley and hailstones flatten surrounding crops, the Go Jetters call for Click ons to defend the area

programme.title: Bluey S01 - Keepy Uppy
programme.desc: Bluey, Bingo and Mum are enjoying playing Keepy-Uppy around the house, when Dad joins in and the game becomes the ultimate test of skill.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Hairdressers
programme.desc: During a game of hairdressers, Bluey discovers that big-headed customer Dad has nits! To help treat them Bingo has to find her voice, while Bluey has to find her ears.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Ragdoll
programme.desc: Dad agrees to take Bluey and Bingo to the shops to buy an ice-cream if they can get him into the car. Only problem is... he's just entered 'Ragdoll' mode!

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Fairy Tale
programme.desc: Dad tells Bluey and Bingo a real-life fairy tale about growing up in a wild place called the '80s, about a boy who was cursed when he was mean to his little brother.

programme.title: Andy's Baby Animal Missions S01 - Andy and the Grizzly Bear Cubs
programme.desc: In this episode Andy, Jen &amp; Scout head to Alaska, in America, on a baby animal mission to solve the mystery of fish being buried underground. Along the way, Andy meets a grizzly bear cub setting out on its first fishing trip with its mother to catch salmon.

programme.title: Playtime Towers S01 - Paper Fan
programme.desc: It's a hot day in Playtime Towers, so Bella helps Lift cool down with a paper fan. Together, they visit Hettie in the Ice Disco, who has a flapping paper fan dance!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S03 - The Favourite Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels learn what a favourite is, but have trouble deciding what their own favourite things are, so they make a film asking some of their friends what is special to them to help narrow it down.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S03 - The Round Up Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels go on the trail of a lost herd of cattle with Duggee and his old pal Rodeo Horse, who teaches them how to be cowhands... and earn their Round Up Badges in the process!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S03 - The Game Show Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels have played all of their board games, so Duggee entertains them by putting on a Game Show, with some help hosting from his good friend Ladybug.

programme.title: Go Jetters S03 - Pirate Peril, Jamaica
programme.desc: While Xuli and Lars help some local divers explore the underwater ruins of Port Royal, Jamaica, Glitch sets off in search of treasure buried by his great-great-great-uncle, Captain Grimbeard. But his efforts cause silt to churn up from the seabed, trapping Lars under the water. Will Xuli manage to get him free before his air runs out?

programme.title: Go Jetters S03 - Funky Fireflies, Selangor River, Malaysia
programme.desc: The Go Jetters are paddling down Malaysia's Selangor River in canoes to look at the region's fireflies. But after a bend in the river, they encounter Glitch attempting to chop down one of the protected mangrove trees, hoping to impress Tala with the rare plant. Although they manage to stop him, the approaching dark and some thick mud leave them in a tricky situation. Can the team work out how to light their way and find their friends?

programme.title: Thomas & Friends S24 - Nia and the Unfriendly Elephant
programme.desc: Nia is excited about being asked to transport a new elephant to the animal park, but the animal is scared of steam trains.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck S03 - Snowball Skate
programme.desc: Sarah and Duck explore a Winter Fair in the park, and discover an amazing skating rink inside a giant snowball!

programme.title: Sarah and Duck S03 - Ribbon Alvida
programme.desc: An excited Sarah and Duck take the Shallots to see the Ribbon Sisters perform with their family circus.

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Holiday
programme.desc: Seamus has booked the wrong date for his and Little Woo's holiday. Stanley repurposes the locations of the town into activities and sights to give them a holiday in a day.

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Dig
programme.desc: Stanley helps Fifi and Fred dig up some shiny stones in their garden that turn out to be old bits of mosaic. With the help of Cynthia and Hettie, they put the pieces back together.

programme.title: Funny Talking Animals S01 - I'm Going To Cannonball In The Pool
programme.desc: Water fights, bodyboarding and ice cream. The funny little animals chat about going on holiday.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran S02 - It's Time for an Indoor Picnic
programme.desc: JoJo and Gran Gran are going to the park to have a picnic when it begins to rain. They have an indoor picnic instead and invite Great-Gran Gran, who is also unable to go out to a barbecue because it is raining in Saint Lucia too. JoJo learns that it can rain in sunny countries.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Curry Quest
programme.desc: Bingo and Dad must brave a swooping magpie protecting its nest, when they go on a curry swap to Mackenzie's house through the park.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Magic
programme.desc: Bluey teaches Bingo how to use magic so she can make Mum play with her, but she forgets to explain the most important rule: never use magic for cheekiness.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Chest
programme.desc: Dad tries to teach Bluey how to play chess, but Mum thinks she is still too young. When Bingo joins in, the kids make up their own rules, but they still can't beat Dad.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Library Badge
programme.desc: When the Squirrels can't figure out if fish have noses, Duggee shows them his library. But when the Squirrels realise no-one is visiting it, they have an idea..

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - Happy's First Day
programme.desc: Happy has always loved the water, even though it makes a mess. But while swimming around in his paddling pool at the playhouse, Duggee reminds the Squirrels that there was a time when Happy feared water.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Splash Dash
programme.desc: Duggie chooses a key and his blue digger to dig up a big bone. The chipmunk makes a delivery to the squirrels.

programme.title: Go Jetters S01 - The Dead Sea, Middle East
programme.desc: The Go Jetters are relaxing by the Dead Sea when Grandmaster Glitch causes a custard catastrophe - to the Vroomster!

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S02 - Cabbage
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's the marvelous Cabbage and his dazzling super-veggie memory skills.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S02 - Gooseberry
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits Theatre, it's Gooseberry, singing a song about everything you have to do to become a Gooseberry Club member.

programme.title: Supertato S01 - Grape Kids' Super Camp
programme.desc: Supertato shows the Grape Kids how to camp Supertato-style, but Evil Pea arrives and wows them with her ice camping. Before long, the Grape Kids need to be rescued by Supertato.

programme.title: Supertato S01 - Operation Kiwi
programme.desc: Supertato, Carrot and Tomato are exploring in the plant aisle when they hear a strange noise. They follow the noise and meet the famous Kiwi the Explorer, who needs their help.

programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - Swap Places
programme.desc: The Teletubbies swap places in the Tubby Car and drive to the Hidey Hup. They swap places again on the Tubby Uppy Downy before going up and down.

programme.title: Marco Polo
programme.desc: Mongolian emperor Kublai Khan is being assassinated while meeting with the Italian explorer Marco Polo. Marco Polo is appointed to lead the troops for the emperor to wipe out the anti-Mongol rebels. Yet, he is touched by these rebels who are resisting the Mongolian invasion of their homeland. Will Marco Polo stay loyal to the emperor?

programme.title: Love With The Perfect Stranger
programme.desc: After breaking up with his girlfriend, salesman Bao meets a rich girl, Jin Jin, who just broke up with her boyfriend. Two equally heartbroken strangers fall in love instantly and get married on impulse. The couple lives happily together until Jin Jin finds herself pregnant with her ex-boyfriend's baby...

programme.title: The Devil's Mirror
programme.desc: A power-hungry Witch who leads the Bloody Ghouls Clan, seeks two magical mirrors, Wind Mirror and Thunder Mirror, which are owned by Bai and the Wen Clan respectively. She needs both mirrors to find the location of a powerful weapon that will make her invincible and will stop at nothing to get her hands on them.

programme.title: Danger has Two Faces
programme.desc: Many years ago, Inspector Kam killed an innocent man and decided to resign from the police force. He became a professional killer who disguises as a pet store owner. When his best friend, Bobby begins investigating recent murder cases committed by Kam, he discovers that the mastermind behind these cases is actually his superintendent.

programme.title: The Swordmates
programme.desc: Li asks his swordmate Wang to protect his family while he is away, but Wang rapes his wife and even has his convoy attacked. Li escaped but fears his daughter is still in danger, so he asks the nephew of his master to help protect her...

programme.title: The Lotus Lamp
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai plays both mother and son in this lavish fable about a goddess who falls in love with a mortal scholar (Cheng Pei-pei in her debut role). Over two years in production, it was released on the first anniversary of Linda's tragic suicide.

programme.title: Chinatown Kid
programme.desc: After getting into trouble with a local gangster, Chui Ho, in Hong Kong, Tam Dong flees to San Francisco and manages to get a job in a restaurant in Chinatown. Tam Dong finds himself embroiled with the gangsters again in San Francisco, and has to fight Chui Ho when the two meet again...

programme.title: Whose Baby is in the Classroom?
programme.desc: Chen, a male teacher in an all girls' high school, is stuck with a baby that isn't his and must take care of it. As he lives on the school grounds, the baby is a source of constant distraction and worry! Luckily, his class warms to the baby and helps him take care of it while he works his charm on Li Ching, an uptight teacher in the same school.

programme.title: The Shadow Whip
programme.desc: Three hundred thousand worth of silver is robbed by a thief using a whip as the weapon. As it is a signature weapon used by a martial arts master "Shadow Whip", he is suspected and hunted. No one sees him after that. Fifteen years later, a young girl Yang shows up using the same weapon. Who is this girl and what has happened to "Shadow Whip"?

programme.title: Moonlight Serenade
programme.desc: A sweet inn-keeper's daughter is witness to a perverted rape, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle. Can her true love rescue her in time? For this movie, the moonlight serenade is the sound of suspense, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle.

programme.title: The Iron Buddha
programme.desc: After a notorious rapist Xiao kills his master and the entire clan, Han the last surviving disciple, decides to take revenge. He must find the legendary Hulong Blade to counter Xiao's Evil Poisonous Sword, but as Han has never seen Xiao before, he is deceived when Xiao poses as an ally to try and steal his Blade in the process.

programme.title: The Three Smiles
programme.desc: A talented scholar, Bo Hu, is attracted by the pretty maid, Qiu Xiang. In order to get close to her and win her love, he disguises as a servant to work in the same household. Qiu Xiang does not believe Bo Hu when he discloses his true identity to her, only falling in love with him when he reveals his talents and with his friends' help.

programme.title: King Eagle
programme.desc: A young swordman, King Eagle, unwillingly gets involved in the internal affairs of a powerful clan and becomes their target. He is saved by the female chief of the clan, Lin, and falls in love with her. However, Lin's sister is part of all evil plots and betrays her. Even so, Lin begs King Eagle not to harm her sister.

programme.title: The Kingdom and the Beauty
programme.desc: Emperor Cheng Te meets country maiden Li Feng on a visit to Southern China. It was love at first sight and the Emperor leaves with a promise that Li Feng would be his empress. When he sends for Li one year later, she was too ill to withstand the arduous journey and arrives just in time to die in the arms of her beloved...

programme.title: The Five Venoms
programme.desc: A dying master dispatches his last pupil to track down five ex-students who are each an expert in his own lethal combat style. He fears they will steal the fortune belonging to their clan and tasks his pupil to prevent their attempt.

programme.title: The Five Venoms
programme.desc: A dying master dispatches his last pupil to track down five ex-students who are each an expert in his own lethal combat style. He fears they will steal the fortune belonging to their clan and tasks his pupil to prevent their attempt.

programme.title: Madam White Snake
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai is perfect as Pak Su-cheng, the stunning snake goddess who assumes a womanly form so that she can taste the pleasures of a human life! Pak seduces young scholar, Hsu Hsien when she recognises him as her saviour in another life 1,000 years ago. But when Buddhist monk Fa Hai finds out about the union, the pair is forced to split...

programme.title: The Tea House
programme.desc: Big Brother Cheng fled from the mainland to Hong Kong, where he opened a teahouse in a housing estate, hoping to find a peaceful life. However, relentless provocations from local triad gangs go unaddressed by the police, prompting Cheng and his friends at the teahouse to seek revenge.

programme.title: The Happiest Moment
programme.desc: This erotic comedy anthology features three stories about an old man who dies from an overdose of virility pills, a cop who goes on the run after extorting money from a hooker, and a barber's apprentice who encounters a lively corpse in a night vigil. Through playing all these characters, Michael Hui proves himself as a genius of Hong Kong comedy.

programme.title: The Supreme Swordsman
programme.desc: After beating several famous swordsmen, Chin Wu Hsin of the Mo Shan clan challenges Supreme Swordsman to a duel, hoping to win his title, and is beaten and humiliated. The winner taunts him to find a Supreme Sword made by Old Eagle, a famous sword-maker. When his offer to buy a sword from Old Eagle, is turned down, he challenges Old Eagle to a duel, and snatches his sword in a foul play. Old Eagle's own son Shih Yen-peh vows to avenge for his father...

programme.title: Na Cha the Great
programme.desc: Adapted from a chapter of the classic Chinese legend "Investiture of the Gods", this is the story of Na Cha set 3000 years ago. After Na Cha sacrificed his life to save his parents, he is reincarnated with his spirit embodied in a lotus flower and is armed with two magic weapons to save the people from their despotic emperor.

programme.title: The Convict Killer
programme.desc: After spending fifteen years in prison on trumped-up charges for drug smuggling, the martial arts master Teng Piao embarks on a journey to take revenge on the person who sets him up - "Black Leopard". Unfortunately for Piao, no one knows the real identity of "Black Leopard", except that there is a black leopard tattoo on his chest.

programme.title: River of Tears
programme.desc: Retired singer Fang lives happily with her husband and son. Tragedy happens when a man from her past returns to haunt her. In an ensuing struggle to free her from his clutches, her husband dies in a car accident. Blamed by her father-in-law for her husband's death, Fang gets chased out of the house and goes back to singing to make a living...

programme.title: Tales of a Eunuch
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao enters the palace and unexpectedly befriends Emperor Kang Xi. At the same time, he is assigned by a revolutionary group to steal the valuable "Sutra of 42 Chapters," which Emperor Kang Xi himself is also seeking. Demonstrating keen intelligence, Xiao Bao deftly navigates between opposing factions and successfully evades danger.

programme.title: The Singing Escort
programme.desc: Betty Ting plays Susan, a young woman hiding from her father by being a nightclub singer in Japan. Pop singer Chao Ke-jen (Lin Chong) gets permission from his boss to visit Japan, with the condition that he finds the boss's daughter. Boy finds girl, boy falls in love. But will the father approve?

programme.title: The Chinese Boxer
programme.desc: A Japanese karate master and Diao Er, who has been expelled from his martial arts school, return to the school to kill the school master and his disciples. After the massacre, disciple Lei Ming embarks on a vigorous training regime and vows to avenge their deaths. A fatal battle is about to begin...

programme.title: The Pearl Phoenix
programme.desc: In Huangmei Opera tradition, this movie tells the love story of Wen, who sells himself as a slave to a rich family, and Huo, the family's young daughter. The lovers are kept apart by Huo's stepmother and Huo escapes by dressing up as a man. Wen is framed and put into jail so Huo has to go back and rescue her lover!

programme.title: The Heroic Ones
programme.desc: Set in the Tang Dynasty, the 13 adopted sons of Sha Tuo King are all renowned as royal warriors. David Chiang plays the 13th Prince, a powerful fighter whose prestigious status provokes jealously, leading to a gruesome family feud.

programme.title: The Warlord
programme.desc: A bandit became a warlord in northern China by helping Russia fight against Japan. Due to his ignorance and silly behaviour, he is seen as a joke to everyone. The warlord is finally killed by the daughter of a troupe master whom he had killed for no reason, bringing a befitting end to a traitor.

programme.title: Reincarnated Swordsman
programme.desc: A Wu Dang disciple Fu, kills the chief of Wu Dang Clan and frames it on the chief's illegitimate child, Yun. Fu then proclaims himself the new chief and orders the killing of Yun, who vows to avenge his father's death and learns the invincible silkworm martial arts style in order to defeat Fu.

programme.title: Reincarnated Swordsman
programme.desc: A Wu Dang disciple Fu, kills the chief of Wu Dang Clan and frames it on the chief's illegitimate child, Yun. Fu then proclaims himself the new chief and orders the killing of Yun, who vows to avenge his father's death and learns the invincible silkworm martial arts style in order to defeat Fu.

programme.title: Double Bliss
programme.desc: Dong and Chu plan to get married but their families who are lifelong rivals, disapproved. They decide to fake suicide and eventually get both of their parents to settle their differences and approve the marriage. Concurrently, a record company announces that they will release Dong's songs, leading to double bliss for the couple.

programme.title: Kid From Kwangtung
programme.desc: Qing enforcer Luo Yi Hu murders rebel Chen Gui, forcing his wife and daughter Xiao Wei to flee to Guang Long Town. There, mischievous Jia Yu discovers his master's identity as a rebel while helping Xiao Wei. After his loved ones and mentor are killed, Jia Yu sheds his playful ways and seeks vengeance, facing the Qing forces in a final battle.

programme.title: Fast Fingers
programme.desc: After his release from prison, Uncle Bill returns to make a fortune with his past thieving partners. They continue to prey on the unsuspecting public, but are closely watched by the upright police chief, who happens to be the boyfriend of one of Uncle Bill's nieces!

programme.title: The Grand Substitution
programme.desc: In this Opera epic, a loyal Imperial Court servant gives up his own newborn son to save the prince from an evil official.

programme.title: The Winged Tiger
programme.desc: If the two big villains Winged Tiger and Underworld King join forces, the martial arts world will be plunged into chaos. This evil union is set to occur with the marriage of the Underworld King's sister and the Winged Tiger. Can this dangerous duo be stopped before one says "I do"?

programme.title: Enchanting Shadow
programme.desc: A young scholar Ning spends the night in a creepy temple that is said to be haunted. He does not believe in the rumours, but soon meets a beautiful female ghost Nie. Nie is forced to stay in the temple to seduce young men for a powerful demon to feast on. Knowing Nie to be a kind ghost, Ning decides to help her escape from the demon's clutches.

programme.title: The Web of Death
programme.desc: To rule the martial arts world, the Head of the Snake Sect seeks to possess a deadly plant called "Five Poison Web", spreading rumours on its whereabouts. Brothers Xiong and Kit are sent to investigate. Xiong falls in love with Su who has a clue of where the plant is, but she accidentally hurts Kit when seeking the plant, devastating Xiong.

programme.title: Mr. Funnybone Strikes Again
programme.desc: In this hilarious sequel, Mr Big Potato opens an old-fashioned Chinese clinic, but his traditional methods are rejected by the sceptics of modern Hong Kong. Enter his buddy Mr Funny bone to rescue his business!

programme.title: The Flying Guillotine
programme.desc: Ma Teng is an assassin of the ‘Flying Guillotine Squad', a group of killers commissioned by the Emperor Yung. When Ma starts to question the morality of his missions, he finds himself becoming a fugitive hunted by his former comrades.

programme.title: The Purple Shell
programme.desc: Hui and Ha are stuck in their unhappy marriages and are attracted to each other when they meet at a party. In one of their beach strolls, Ha picks up a purple shell and gives it to Hui as a memento. When Hui's husband finds out about them, he hurts Hui and causes her to become seriously ill, while also blackmails Ha. How will this love story end?

programme.title: Super Inframan
programme.desc: Transformed from a young laboratory researcher, the thunderbolt-fisted Inframan must battle Princess Dragon Mom who wakes up from hibernation to conquer the earth with her army of mutant monsters.

programme.title: Les Belles
programme.desc: Acknowledged as one of the greatest Hong Kong musicals, this lavish movie starring Linda Lin, who won Best Actress for her performance, infuses its wispy plot with style and wit, and the results are pure pleasure.

programme.title: The Silent Swordsman
programme.desc: Young swordsman Shen Bing Yi is appointed leader of the "Sun and Moon" secret society, sworn to take down a traitorous general conspiring with foreign invaders. While fighting for his nation, he captures the hearts of a spirited female warrior and two beautiful Uyghur princesses, leaving him caught between his duty and their devotion.

programme.title: The House of 72 Tenants
programme.desc: The 72 inhabitants of a dilapidated tenement live under the thumb of a heartless landlady and her sleazy husband. The arrival of a defiant new tenant however, changes their fate. The residents pool their resources together to prevent evictions, deflect targeted harassment by a corrupt policeman and ultimately prevent their home from being sold.

programme.title: Ip Man
programme.desc: Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man’s matchless fighting skills are revered all over China. Set during the Sino-Japanese War, Ip Man is forced to leave his home and work to support his family. With only his martial arts skills, he reluctantly agrees to train others in the art of Wing Chun for self-defense.

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: Dragon Master: Dragon Spell
programme.desc: The Dragon King is locked in a seal by the Dragon Master for 500 years, and his daughter must travel back in time to 500 years ago to kill the Dragon Master, in order to reverse the act. Little did she know that the Dragon King and Dragon Master were close friends back then…

programme.title: Let's Have a Baby
programme.desc: De Sheng and Wan Jun have been married for years, but are unable to conceive. Wan Jun decides to undergo artificial insemination in the States and finally gets pregnant. She meets her cousin from the States who stays temporarily in their house with them, and De Sheng begins to suspect that they are having an affair…

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsu's funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him…

programme.title: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon
programme.desc: The legendary swordsman Li, entrusts the Green Destiny sword to a noble house for safekeeping. It is swiftly stolen by Yu, a young aristocrat of immense martial skills trained by an unscrupulous outlaw master. Recognising her talent, Li tries to guide her towards righteousness but ultimately leads them both to a tragic fate.

programme.title: Law Or Justice
programme.desc: Lawyer Yip defends a rapist and gets him acquitted. Yip’s boyfriend Fong, a police inspector, knows he is guilty and despises Yip for not upholding justice. The victim’s sister takes revenge by spiking the rapist’s drink but is raped instead. This puts the rapist back in court. Will Yip choose to uphold law or justice this time?

programme.title: Hidden Heroine
programme.desc: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Women’s Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Mei’s father as an undercover is exposed. After a fierce battle, Mei and her team manage to successfully defeat the drug cartel and rescue her father.

programme.title: Fate Jealous Greed
programme.desc: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death; while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him; three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

programme.title: From Beijing With Love
programme.desc: A reactivated backup Chinese agent, posing as a butcher, is unexpectedly assigned to recover a stolen dinosaur skull. Sent to Hong Kong, he is aided by a female agent who is secretly working for the villains. Together, they navigate betrayals and confront the mastermind, ultimately recovering the national treasure and exposing the conspiracy.

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: Hong Kong police officer Ah Shan goes undercover in prison to gain the trust of criminal Tian and seek evidence against his gang. After their release, Shan helps Tian rise within the gang and become the new boss. However, as Shan cracks down on the gang, he uncovers a shocking secret about Tian...

programme.title: Fight Back to School III
programme.desc: When millionaire Wong is found murdered in a hotel room, Sing, who bears a striking resemblance to the victim, goes undercover as the deceased to investigate the case. With Wong's marriage already on the rocks, his wife becomes the prime suspect. However, Sing soon uncovers that Wong's close friend is suspicious as well...

programme.title: Nezha
programme.desc: A former top team racing driver wants to prove himself in a race but accidentally hurts his teammate Lily, leading to the team’s downfall. When an inexperienced virtual car racing champion joins the team and unexpectedly shines in a real-life race, can the three drivers team up to regain glory for their team?

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh II
programme.desc: Bodyguard Ah Sun is sent to protect his boss' son, only to meet and fall in love with his mistress, the gorgeous Joey. As love blossoms between the two, the powerful boss finds out and all hell breaks loose!

programme.title: The Grandmaster
programme.desc: Directed by the acclaimed filmmaker Wong Kar Wai, this epic action feature begins in Foshan when Ip Man, the martial arts master from the south, takes up a challenge by ageing northern master Gong Yu Tian. Ip Man wins the fight, but is then defeated by Gong Yu Tian’s daughter Gong Er, with whom he forms an emotional bond…

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Comparing to the director's previous Hex. This time, however, the stakes are even higher and the gruesome goings-on even more memorable. It all starts when a noble police detective starts investigating a child killer's claims of an evil spell, then it doesn't let up until the final, bloated, maggot-ridden cadaver falls.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Comparing to the director's previous Hex. This time, however, the stakes are even higher and the gruesome goings-on even more memorable. It all starts when a noble police detective starts investigating a child killer's claims of an evil spell, then it doesn't let up until the final, bloated, maggot-ridden cadaver falls.

programme.title: Girl with the Diamond Slipper
programme.desc: An aspiring TV actress gets into hot water when a stolen diamond is hidden in the shoes she bought for a party.

programme.title: Mr Vampire III
programme.desc: Taoist conman Ming fails to banish vengeful spirits and escapes with his ghostly companions. As they seek refuge in a village, they encounter an evil witch whose goal is to eliminate the human race. Ming then allies with Taoist priest Master Jiu to battle the witch—but can they prevail against such overwhelming darkness?

programme.title: Flying Swords of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: This is a remake of the original 1966 classic, Dragon Gate Inn. The country is being policed by the East and West Bureaus, whilst the Emperor’s eunuchs have attained much power and control. With all the corruption, Zhao teams up with a group of assassins to systemically kill the eunuchs in order to save the country.

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yue's house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

programme.title: The Accidental Spy
programme.desc: Gifted salesman Siu Buck travels to Turkey to uncover his roots, only to find himself entangled in his spy father's dangerous legacy. Caught in an international conspiracy involving a lethal bioterror threat, he is thrust into a high-stakes chase. As danger closes in, Buck must push beyond his limits to stop a global crisis.

programme.title: Mr Vampire Saga 4
programme.desc: A Buddhist monk and Taoist priest put aside their differences to take on vampires that have been struck by lightning and have now become a super powered threat to mankind.

programme.title: 36 Secrets of Courtship
programme.desc: This erotic comedy features three lotharios who vie to become principal of the Macho Man Training School -- an extremely sexy institution dedicated to extremely non Shaolin-types of physical exertion.

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Gangster Chen Da Qi rises to the upper echelons of power, but finds himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: VR Fighter
programme.desc: Bodyguard Long Wei has post‐traumatic stress disorder after his wife's death. One day, he encounters Amy who works for a VR technology firm and is invited for a new product test. After the test, Long Wei becomes the firm’s VR fighter and dons the newly invented armour. However, as mysterious armed men break in, a fierce battle has just begun...

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school’s stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: Seoul Raiders
programme.desc: A special agent from the Japanese National Security teams up with a skilled thief to find a pair of plates used to make counterfeit USD. However, a US Embassy representative appears and steals the plates, running away to Korea with them.

programme.title: Love in a Fallen City
programme.desc: Based on a novel of the same name by the famous novelist Eileen Chang and directed by the equally acclaimed director Ann Hui, this romance story depicts the challenging relationship between an introverted Shanghai divorcee and a cynical Malaysian playboy during the Japanese invasion of Hong Kong in the 1940s. Will the lovers be together in the end?

programme.title: I Love Lolanto
programme.desc: Lolanto, a playboy, is injured and meets the daughter of a tycoon, Man, in the hospital. Man is mentally retarded and makes friends easily with Lolanto hence Man’s father hires him to take care of her. However, as Man goes through treatments and recovers, her feelings for Lolanto also changes…

programme.title: I Love Lolanto
programme.desc: Lolanto, a playboy, is injured and meets the daughter of a tycoon, Man, in the hospital. Man is mentally retarded and makes friends easily with Lolanto hence Man’s father hires him to take care of her. However, as Man goes through treatments and recovers, her feelings for Lolanto also changes…

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: During World War II, a singer was raped and killed by Master Tao during her escape, with all her valuables stolen as well. Since then, the Tao’s house became haunted. Years later, Master Tao’s descendant sells the house to a young couple to pay off a massive gambling debt, but the couple soon discover that it is haunted by the vengeful spirit...

programme.title: Blind War
programme.desc: Former SWAT captain Dong Gu suffers traumatic visual loss during a failed mission for which he is forced to take responsibility. He manages to get over and adapt to the situation with his daughter’s company, until his nemesis appears and puts his daughter in danger. Despite being blind, Dong Gu must fight to save his daughter.

programme.title: How to Pick Girls Up !
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: Jealousy
programme.desc: Model Min is admitted to a hospital, but mysteriously falls to her death at night. Rumour has it that the hospital is haunted. Subsequently, Min's photographer begins receiving eerie phone calls, the writer loses consciousness in a bizarre car accident, and her friend mysteriously disappears…

programme.title: Munitions Hijacking Case
programme.desc: Agent Wen is assigned to work undercover for a Southeast Asian arms dealer to locate and destroy a cache of munitions. However, when he finally finds them, he is attacked by unknown gangsters and must team up with his partner to recover the weapons and prevent a disaster.

programme.title: The Revenge
programme.desc: Ruo Wei returns to her childhood home with two best friends, and reunites with her cousin who has always lived there. While they plan to enjoy their trip, they are constantly haunted by paranormal events, ending up in a terrifying experience with unexpected outcome.

programme.title: Royal Tramp II
programme.desc: The leader of Dragon clan, Long Er, helps General Wu to overthrow Emperor Kang Xi. However, Long Er is betrayed by General Wu and is rescued by Xiao Bao. As a result, she bestows her virginity and martial arts power to Xiao Bao to fight against Wu. At the same time, Xiao Bao fortuitously unveils the hidden treasures from “The Sutra of 42 Chapters”.

programme.title: Destiny's Champion
programme.desc: An aging fighter relives the mistakes of his violent past through a poor and streetwise kid, who severely injures his nemesis during a battle to win a girl's heart.

programme.title: Get in the Dark
programme.desc: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiao’s spirit is revived to take revenge when the doll’s eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

programme.title: The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud
programme.desc: 18 years ago, the evil Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil. When the baby grows up, he takes control of the mask and becomes Fire Cloud’s successor as the city’s guard.

programme.title: Fight Back to School II
programme.desc: Following his demotion, officer Sing resigns from the police force and goes undercover at an international school to privately investigate a terrorist plot. There, he discovers bumbling detective Tat posing as a teacher. Forced into an alliance, they team up to confront the heavily armed criminals behind the plot in a chaotic showdown.

programme.title: The Stormriders
programme.desc: Driven by prophecy, Lord Conqueror murders Wind and Cloud's parents, then raises the boys as his own. Years later, their power rivals his, so he secretly plots their deaths. However, when his daughter falls for both young men, jealousy ignites. The moment he betroths her to Wind, a fatal battle becomes inevitable.

programme.title: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: An old lady died after mysteriously falling off a building and her ghost appears to haunt the place. This freaked out the security guards, who invite ghostbuster Leo and his female assistant to help. In the process, Leo finds out that the old lady was killed by her son and daughter in law. To rest her soul, Leo promises to bring the couple to justice.

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: Mr. Virgin is a romantic comedy about a twenty-nine year-old man Chao Yu-ting (Alfred Chang) who has seemingly been cursed. He becomes paranoid when a Feng Shui expert tells him it will be unlucky for him to marry before the age of thirty... so comical chaos line the days up to his next birthday!

programme.title: A Man Called Hero
programme.desc: In 1913, a brutal massacre forces Hua into exile in America. Reunited with his pregnant wife, tragedy strikes again when their home burns down on the night she gives birth to twins, killing her while their daughter gets kidnapped. Sixteen years later, as his son finds him, Hua confronts his ultimate nemesis in a climactic duel on top of the Statue of Liberty.

programme.title: Global Business

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Angor Management
programme.desc: Jim and Strickler team up to bring down Angor Rot Meanwhile the Gnome returns with important information regarding Baby Enrique.

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S1 - A Night To Remember
programme.desc: Jim must convince Strickler to cut the bond to his mom while Claire and Toby sneak into his office during the Spring Fling Dance for the incantation.

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - The Big Sleep
programme.desc: Aja and Krel travel into their parents’ memories in pursuit of Morando – and the truth about Gaylen’s Core. But when the King and Queen’s lives are jeopardized, a trusted ally makes a sacrifice that will change the team forever.

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Race to Trollmarket
programme.desc: With their parents nearly regenerated and Morando in pursuit of Gaylen’s Core, Aja, Krel, and Vex unite with Toby and Arrgh on a quest into the depths of Trollmarket to unearth the relic before it ends up in the wrong hands.

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - A Glorious End, Part One
programme.desc: Armed with the power of Gaylen's Core, Morando's forces attack Arcadia as the Royals fight to protect their lives and their adopted Earth home.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Itty Bitty Blossom
programme.desc: The dollhouse delivery is a special plant called an Itty Bitty Blossom that goes from newborn to full-grown in one day. Gabby and Pandy have to take care of the whiny and fussy growing Itty Bitty Blossom and make sure it is in its permanent soil spot before it's fully grown.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Dollhouse Store Day
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes a coin purse with kitty coins, it's Store Day in the dollhouse! Gabby and Pandy help out at all the different stores (Cakey's Bakery, Baby Box's Craft Emporium, Kitty Fairy's Flower Shoppe) to earn kitty coins and save up for a melodicat at the Grand Opening of DJ Catnip’s Music Store!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Kitty Fairy's Sleepover
programme.desc: When Gabby, Pandy and the Gabby Cats prepare for a sleepover in the Garden, they discover Pillow Cat has never been to a sleepover. They help her conquer her fears and enjoy her first sleepover.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Let's Make A Movie!
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes two little containers of popcorn and two movie tickets, it’s movie night in the dollhouse! Demanding Director CatRat leads the Gabby Cats through a Gabby-fied version of a classic story, Gabby-locks and the Three Bears.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Pete The Polar Bear
programme.desc: Pete the Polar Bear shows up for a vacation on MerCat’s sunny beach. Gabby, Pandy, and the Gabby Cats show Pete he can have a great vacation, even if things don’t go precisely to plan.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S1 - Family Fun Night
programme.desc: The Templetons head to a new family restaurant only to run into Bootsy Calico!

programme.title: Casper's Scare School S1 - Scare Scouts Boo
programme.desc: Scare Scouts When Frankengymteacher forms a scout troop, Casper is the first to sign up. Boo! During a visit to Deedstown, Casper and his friends are shocked to find the humans dressed as scary creatures…it must Halloween!

programme.title: Casper's Scare School S1 - Abra-Ca-Deedstown Shrinky Dust
programme.desc: Abra-Ca-Deedstown From cleaning Ra's sarcophagus, to starring in Jimmy's magic act, Casper has been helping so much, he's exhausted. Shrinky Dust When magical Shrinky Dust falls into Norman the bully's hands, Casper and Jimmy find themselves on a hunt to get it back.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Game Show
programme.desc: It’s Game Show Day in the dollhouse! Our wily and well-groomed host, CatRat, leads Gabby and Pandy around the dollhouse, where they compete in Gab-ified games, like Tushy Tunes on the “butt xylophone” couch and a cooking competition of Bakey with Cakey. They win tickets and trade them in for prizes at the end.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - Tea Time’s Up Barks, Baths, and Beyond
programme.desc: When Athena thinks Lola no longer wants to have their weekly tea party, a tradition they’ve had as long as Athena can remember, Athena tries everything she can to get Lola to have another one. When Tracy and Harper accidentally leave Wilford at home, on their way to the Fairhaven Pet Get Together, it’s up to the Dew Drops to get him to the park on time. But because it just rained, getting Wilford there clean proves to be a challenge.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - The Secret Ingredient Delete That Dew!
programme.desc: When Harper is missing an ingredient to make her Mom’s favorite dessert on Mother’s Day, Eden enlists the help of her fellow Dew Drops to do an emergency city-wide ingredient search! When Marcus records a video of his inventions, Phoebe gets caught on camera and must erase the footage before Marcus sees, or her Dew Drop cover will be blown!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Game Show
programme.desc: It’s Game Show Day in the dollhouse! Our wily and well-groomed host, CatRat, leads Gabby and Pandy around the dollhouse, where they compete in Gab-ified games, like Tushy Tunes on the “butt xylophone” couch and a cooking competition of Bakey with Cakey. They win tickets and trade them in for prizes at the end.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Kitty Pirates
programme.desc: Gabby unboxes a pirate treasure map in the shape of the dollhouse (a piece of it has been torn off). This must mean it’s time for a pirate treasure hunt in the dollhouse! Pirate Gabby and Pirate Pandy head out on their journey across the many “lands” of the dollhouse to find the Gabby Cats Treasure!

programme.title: Madagascar: A Little Wild S1 - CupKate
programme.desc: It’s Kate’s birthday and everyone in the habitat has something amazing planned- but Melman’s worried that his homemadehoof-made gift won’t measure up. While on a no-holds barred quest to get Kate her favorite cupcakes, Melman learns the gift doesn’t matter, as long as it comes from the heart.

programme.title: Madagascar: A Little Wild S1 - Pest Side Story
programme.desc: Gloria becomes determined to earn her Queen of Kindness Kidizen badge and welcomes some free-spirited rats who need a place to stay into the habitat. Despite her discomfort, Gloria encourages the rats to make themselves at home. When the rats play with her special baby tusk at the bottom of her tank, she finally snaps and sends the rats home. It isn't until the gang winds up at the rats' nest and Gloria almost takes a slice of the rats special cheese that she learns it's okay to say no.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Message in a Bubble Glitteretti
programme.desc: Kelp has a new trick with his bubbles: he can have his friends put voice messages inside that you hear when you pop them. But when Pixie decides she doesn’t want the others to hear what’s in her bubble, the chase is on to rescue it! Juniper is devastated when the traditional ceremony to celebrate her next level of spark achievement can’t happen. Kelp helps introduce a new tradition.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Talent Show Sad Sad Plant
programme.desc: Kelp writes a song about him and Scallop to perform at the unicorn show. But when it comes time, Scallop wants to keep the song “just for them”, leaving Kelp to come up with anew act- and fast! The kids all visit the magical musical plant greenhouse on Unicorn Land. They each pick a plant to take care of, and for Kelp it’s a sad, almost dead plant that he falls in love with.

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go! S1 - Happy Birthday Pawston
programme.desc: Tag and Scooch embark on a road trip to Chew York City to track down Kelly Korgi to ask her to perform at Pawston’s 100th birthday party.\ When Kelly Korgi tells Tag she can’t perform at Pawston’s 100th birthday party, she and Scooch decide to create a Kelly Korgi replacement so that she doesn’t break her promise to the town.

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go! S1 - Big Dog Job The Case of the Slobbery
programme.desc: Tag tries to prove to Mom that she’s a big dog by puppysitting Yip and Rhonda all day. All she has to do is get them to the playground, but the pups keep running off. \ When a giant, bone-shaped, roller coaster ride goes missing from the Amusement Bark, Detectives Tag and Scooch take on the case of the slobbery robbery.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - Photo Day Disaster The Eightful Eight
programme.desc: When Rodney heads to the Community Center for Junior Security Cadet picture day, TZG secretly helps him stay neat and clean for the photo shoot. When Luis worries about his first ever math test, TZG secretly helps steady his nerves.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - Robo-Dog Day Afternoon Spoiler Alert
programme.desc: New girl in town Felicia shows off her robo-dog but it runs out of control, and TZG must secretly stop the barking bot from wreaking havoc. When Lula starts gathering birthday wishes from folks around town, TZG secretly keeps her surprise party under wraps.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Grumblegard, Part 1
programme.desc: While the others care for baby dragons at the roost, Dak, Winger, Burple and Aggro come face-to-face with a grumpy old dragon on a dangerous island.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Grumblegard, Part 2
programme.desc: The Rescue Riders plan to team up with the Slinkwings when an angry Grumblegard threatens Huttsgalor. But their old enemies may be up to new tricks.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - Dollhouse Fairy Tales
programme.desc: The Gabby Cats put their own spin on the classic fairytales "Rapunzel," "The Princess and the Pea," and "Little Red Riding Hood." For the Cat of the Day Segment, CatRat sings a song!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - Happy CAT-O-Ween
programme.desc: It’s Cat-O-Ween in the dollhouse, and all the Gabby Cats are in the holiday spirit. Gabby and Pandy dress up and go trick-or-treating around the dollhouse, where they make cat-o-lanterns with Baby Box, search for hidden treats with MerCat, and make Banana ghosts with Cakey. Along the way, CatRat plays silly tricks on them, but in the end Floyd manages to trick them all! For the Cat of the Day segment, all the Gabby Cats sing a special Cat-O-Ween song.

programme.title: The Mr. Peabody And Sherman Show S1 - Outbreak Ancient Greek Games
programme.desc: Sherman accidentally finds the cure for a prehistoric bird flu turning everyone blue; Zeus's team of titans face off against a gawky geek squad.

programme.title: The Mr. Peabody And Sherman Show S1 - Show On The RoadCatherine The Great
programme.desc: Peabody and Sherman try to do the show in a new city but end up on the moon instead and must get home before astronauts take over the penthouse

programme.title: The Adventures Of Puss In Boots S1 - Star
programme.desc: Dulcinea finds a wishing star and decides to use it to help San Lorenzo, but all of her wishes wind up in chaos.

programme.title: The Adventures Of Puss In Boots S1 - Pigs
programme.desc: Toby's ninja brother Brandt returns to San Lorenzo, and Puss agrees to help him reunite with his brothers – to get them out of town.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Paws Of Destiny S1 - End of the Dragon Master
programme.desc: Po, the kids, and the new Panda Guardians must work together to defeat Jindiao once and for all, and get a visit from an unlikely source

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Paws Of Destiny S1 - Journey to the East
programme.desc: Feeling a little bored with their new hero life, Po and the kids are excited to accept an important invitation to the Forbidden City. Meanwhile, there's a curious disturbance deep in Panda Village...

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free: Riding Academy S3 - The S. S. Friend-ship
programme.desc: After the PALs encourage Maricela to make new friends, she forms the exclusive "Poshy Posse" with Priya, Sahir and Alex.

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free: Riding Academy S3 - The Gavel of Justice
programme.desc: Someone stole Bebe's gavel and used it to break a window at the academy! Everyone seems to suspect Alex ... but Pru is certain he's innocent.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S2 - Ragnarok: Part 1
programme.desc: Tom’s overconfidence turns to frustration then despair as he struggles to procure the ingredients for Gronckle Iron in hopes of building a trap to stop the World Serpent.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S2 - Ragnarok: Part 2
programme.desc: After a major miscalculation by Tom in 225 leaves the fate of the Realms in jeopardy, Jun and the riders rally behind Tom and Thunder to face off against the World Serpent.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S2 - Hobs and Saw
programme.desc: When Phil threatens to shut down D’Angelo’s new dragon hospital and ban dragons from ICARIS, D’Angelo and a little Hobgobbler have to change his mind.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and The Frenzied Farts of Flabby Flabulous
programme.desc: George and Harold create a comic book about their gym teacher, but after a freak accident turns fantasy into reality, the best friends must run from his revenge

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and The Dreadful Debacle of DJ Drowsy Drawers
programme.desc: George and Harold attempt to save the fun at their school dance, but matters are made worse when their music teachers transforms into the dull yet deadly villain DJ Drowsy Drawers

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and The Horrible Hostilities of the Homework Hydra
programme.desc: When George and Harold go back in time to stop the invention of homework, they realize they also eliminated the most important thing in the world: comic books

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S1 - Home Punch Home
programme.desc: Tired of the farm's feud with the neighboring punch monkeys, Ugga arranges a punch summit where the Bettermans and Croods will stay in the punch monkey village to learn how to all get along.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S1 - Goodbye Crood World
programme.desc: When Phil detects a meteor is hurtling towards the farm, the Bettermans and Croods must decide how to spend their last day on earth.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S1 - Sticky Business
programme.desc: Struggling to find their purpose on the Betterman farm, the Croods see an opportunity to prove their worth by harvesting Phil’s perilous (and sticky) bounceberries.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S2 - Ragnarok: Part 1
programme.desc: Tom’s overconfidence turns to frustration then despair as he struggles to procure the ingredients for Gronckle Iron in hopes of building a trap to stop the World Serpent.
